faqs.q: What terminal is Delta at JFK?
faqs.a: Delta operates from Terminal 4. That is the official JFK airline directory assignment. After baggage claim, Aria meets you in public arrivals — including past customs on international flights.

faqs.q: What terminal is JetBlue at JFK?
faqs.a: JetBlue’s home is Terminal 5. The official directory also notes that late-night international arrivals (10:30 p.m. to 5:00 a.m.) process at Terminal 4. Put your flight number on the booking so we meet you at the correct hall.

faqs.q: What terminal is American Airlines at JFK?
faqs.a: American Airlines operates from Terminal 8. Aria meets you in T8 arrivals after baggage claim.

faqs.q: What terminal is British Airways at JFK?
faqs.a: British Airways is listed at Terminal 8 on the official JFK airline directory — the same terminal as American and several oneworld partners. Confirm in the BA app the day you fly.

faqs.q: What terminal is Emirates at JFK?
faqs.a: Emirates operates from Terminal 4. After you clear U.S. Customs and collect bags, the chauffeur meets you in the public arrivals hall past customs.

faqs.q: What terminal is Lufthansa at JFK?
faqs.a: Lufthansa is listed at Terminal 1 on the official JFK airline directory. Allow extra time on the T1 roadway while the New Terminal One project is under construction.

faqs.q: Is JFK Terminal 2 open?
faqs.a: No. Terminal 2 is closed and demolished. It is not on the official JFK terminals list. If an old email or map says T2, check your airline app.

faqs.q: Is JFK Terminal 7 still open in 2026?
faqs.a: Yes. The official JFK directory still lists T7 airlines including Aer Lingus, Air Canada, ANA, Frontier, Icelandair, and Norse. The official T7 page notes construction and a temporary ride-app pickup move to Howard Beach AirTrain. Aria still meets you inside T7 arrivals — confirm your terminal the day you travel because the new Terminal 6 is being built on the former T6 and T7 sites.

faqs.q: How much is Aria from Manhattan to JFK?
faqs.a: Base flat rate is $165 sedan or $250 SUV, including standard tolls, flight tracking, and 60 minutes of airport wait. At checkout Aria itemizes 20% gratuity, 8.87% NYS sales tax, and 3.5% card processing — about $218 for the sedan. No surge.

faqs.q: Is the JFK AirTrain free?
faqs.a: AirTrain is free between terminals and to on-airport stops such as Federal Circle and Lefferts Boulevard. The official one-way fare is $8.75 when you enter or exit at Jamaica or Howard Beach. Children under five ride free.

faqs.q: Where does Aria meet international arrivals at Terminal 4?
faqs.a: Past customs, in the public arrivals hall, with a name sign. Clear CBP, collect checked bags, then walk into the public area. Do not wait airside. Add your flight number so we track delays.

faqs.q: How do I book JFK car service?
faqs.a: Book at https://book.ariablackcarservice.com/book or call (888) 402-8202, 24/7. Online booking needs 12 hours’ notice when possible; same-day pickups should call dispatch.
